newsitem.title: USA: American Intl says wins Kazakh license.
newsitem.headline: American Intl says wins Kazakh license.

text.p: American International Petroleum Corp said on Monday that the government of Kazakhstan had agreed to transfer the oil and gas exploration license number 853 to its 70 percent owned MED Shipping Usturt Petroleum joint venture.

Last Thursday, American International said estimated reserves in the seven geological formations in its Caspian Sea block were 1.1 billion barrels of oil. This has driven the shares price up from around 63 cents to 2-15/16 by 1100 EST on Monday, with 7.5 million shares traded today, out of a float of 30 million.
The company said it still has nine large structures to evaluate and that one of these, the 50 kilometre long Chidkuk structure, which could hold the largest reserves.
